content: russianДомино is the only target noun in the RUSSE'18 that has no inflected forms, since it is a borrowed word. This leaves no room for improvement when using lemma-based ELMo models: all tokens of this word are already identical. At the same time, some information about inflected word forms in the context can be useful, but it is lost during lemmatization, and this leads to the decreased score. Arguably, this means that lemmatization brings along both advantages and disadvantages for WSD with ELMo. For inflected words (which constitute the majority of Russian vocabulary) profits outweigh the losses, but for atypical non-changeable words it can be the opposite.
